parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value for this parameter from your client and make sure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the service instance resides.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the service instance.

You can call the [ListServiceInstances](~~396200~~) operation to query the IDs of service instances.
